### Time picker
Pick a time from a clock face, in 12-hour or 24-hour form.

Component ID: `time-picker`

#### Selection and adaptation

Runtime ownership: `auto-init`. [Google guidance](https://m3.material.io/components/time-pickers/overview)

Public JavaScript exports: `Timepicker`. See the [API index](../references/api-index.md).

Example: An appointment time can use a labeled native time input when platform entry is enough. Timepicker defaults to a visible inline clock; choose displayPlugin: 'docked' or 'modal' for a popup.

#### Contract

Add `time-picker` to a text input. `AutoInit()` starts every `.time-picker` except those marked `no-autoinit`.

The clock defaults to a visible inline view appended to the input's parent. Use `displayPlugin: 'docked'` for a popover or `'modal'` for a dialog. There is no `openByDefault` flag, and the picker instance provides no `open()` or `close()` methods.

#### Syntax

```html
<div class="field">
  <input type="text" class="time-picker" id="lunchtime">
  <label for="lunchtime">Lunchtime</label>
</div>
```

#### Options

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `duration` | Number | `350` | Transition between the hours and minutes views, in milliseconds. |
| `container` | Element or String | `null` | Element or selector to render the clock into. When omitted, it is appended to the input’s parent. |
| `showClearBtn` | Boolean | `false` | Show a Clear button in the footer. |
| `autoSubmit` | Boolean | `true` | If true, choosing a minute writes the input. If false, Ok and Cancel buttons are added. |
| `defaultTime` | String | `'now'` | Initial time. `'now'` or a `'HH:MM'` or `'HH:MM:SS'` string (optionally with `AM`/`PM`). |
| `fromNow` | Number | `0` | Millisecond offset added to `'now'`. |
| `i18n` | Object | See below | Labels for Cancel, Clear, Ok, Hours, Minutes and Seconds. |
| `twelveHour` | Boolean | `true`, or the language's | If true, use a 12-hour clock with AM/PM. If false, use 24-hour hours on two rings. With a `lang` on or around the input, defaults to the clock that language uses. |
| `showSeconds` | Boolean | `false` | Add a seconds field after the minutes and write `HH:MM:SS`. The dial still sets hours and minutes only. |
| `minTime` | String | `null` | The earliest time a person can choose, as 24-hour `HH:MM` or `HH:MM:SS`. Without `showSeconds` it rounds up to a whole minute. |
| `maxTime` | String | `null` | The latest time a person can choose, as 24-hour `HH:MM` or `HH:MM:SS`. Without `showSeconds` it rounds down to a whole minute. |
| `vibrate` | Boolean | `true` | Vibrate the device when the clock hand changes value. |
| `onSelect` | Function | `null` | Called when a time is chosen on the dial. Receives `(hour, minute)`. |
| `onInputInteraction` | Function | `null` | Called when the input is clicked or confirmed with Enter. |
| `onDone` | Function | `null` | Called once when Ok is activated by click, Enter or Space. The button is created when `autoSubmit` is false. |
| `onCancel` | Function | `null` | Called once when Cancel is activated by click, Enter or Space. The button is created when `autoSubmit` is false. |
| `displayPlugin` | String | `null` | Set to `'docked'` for a click-to-open popover, or `'modal'` for a dialog with Cancel and Ok. |
| `displayPluginOptions` | Object | `null` | Options for the docked plugin: `margin`, `transition`, `duration`, `align`. The modal plugin takes none. |

#### Internationalization

Pass a partial `i18n` object. Missing keys keep the English defaults.

| Key | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `cancel` | `'Cancel'` |
| `clear` | `'Clear'` |
| `done` | `'Ok'` |

`i18n.hours`, `i18n.minutes` and `i18n.seconds` default to `Hours`, `Minutes` and `Seconds` and provide accessible input names. AM/PM buttons expose their selected state and support Enter and Space. The hour, minute and second fields are spin buttons: Up and Down step them by one and Page Up and Page Down by five, wrapping round, and the hand follows the hour and minute. Hours step round the day, so in 12-hour time passing 12 switches AM and PM: up from 11 AM comes 12 PM. Tab moves between controls. The dial itself takes pointer input only: the spin buttons already set the same values from the keyboard and to a screen reader, so a focusable dial would only add a second Tab stop for them.

#### Methods

- `.showView()`: Show the hours or minutes face.
- `.done()`: Write the current time to the input, with seconds when `showSeconds` is on. Pass a truthy argument to clear the input instead.
- `.clear()`: Clear the input. Same as `done(true)`.
- `.destroy()`: Destroy the plugin instance, remove the clock, and tear down its event handlers. Pending automatic submission and clock updates are cancelled, so the destroyed instance cannot write to the input.
- `.open(); / .close()`: These methods are not provided. The clock defaults to visible inline presentation; `displayPlugin: 'docked'` enables docking and `displayPlugin: 'modal'` opens it in a dialog from the input.
